text:
devin: Quick heads-up — planning to cut a release branch for v1.12.0 at 15:00 PT (about 2 hours). Please flag any last-minute blockers. Need: version bump PR, changelog entry, docs ship, QA sign-off, security review. PR for core changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4812

maria: ack, will finish the version bump and changelog in a couple hrs. I'll open the bump PR and tag y'all.

rajesh: I can run the smoke suite right after branch cut. Anything specific to watch for? e2e flakiness on streaming routes?

devin: yes, primarily streaming and the new model routing config. If tests hit timeouts, ping me and I'll temporarily raise the timeout on the canary job.

sara: docs update is WIP — added a new note about model pinning and rollout policy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/223

tim: security review done for PR 4812 — no new vulns. Left a tiny comment about log redaction (non-blocking).

alex: heads up — I pushed a tiny fix to the quantization path that needs a patch bump. Will include in the bump PR. Might require one extra smoke run.

devin: cool. Maria, can you include the following in the changelog: a short blurb about the quantization fix + doc link? format: `v1.12.0 — fixes: quant path crash; docs: model pinning guide (PR #223)`.

maria: yep. Drafting now. Planning to open `platform` version-bump PR with changelog and `package.json` update: `git checkout -b release/v1.12.0 && git commit -am "chore(release): v1.12.0"`

rajesh: I'll queue smoke after branch is created. Can someone post the exact branch name so CI matches?

devin: branch will be `release/v1.12.0`. CI jobs: `smoke`, `canary-e2e`, `prod-sim` — please watch `canary-e2e`.

sara: docs PR merged into `main` already. I'll cherry-pick into release branch once cut unless you want me to open a release PR against `release/v1.12.0`.

dev-infra-bot: reminder: release branch cutoff in ~90 minutes. Run `./scripts/release-checklist.sh` to verify pre-cut items.

maria: opening PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4820 (includes bump + changelog + alex's patch).

tim: re: audit, I've attached a short checklist in the PR. If you want a quick automated scan, I can trigger the security-linter job.

alex: ran local e2e; saw one flaky on streaming. Re-ran and it passed. I'll watch the flake on CI.

rajesh: smoke run queued against `release/v1.12.0` after PR merge. ETA ~10–15m.

devin: plan: merge bump PR at 15:00 PT, cut branch, run smoke then canary. If canary is green for 30m, proceed with release tagging. If canary fails, fallback to `main` model variant until fix.

maria: LGTM from me. @tim please confirm security-ok in PR comments for merging.

tim: confirmed in PR comments. security-linter ran clean.

sara: I'll prepare the docs cherry-pick and open a follow-up PR against the release branch in case the branch diverges.

dev-infra-bot: action: scheduled canary deployment at 15:15 PT.

oncall-bot: alert: will notify @pager on release failures if canary fails > 2x within 20m.

alex: minor ask — after branch cut, can we hold off on any other non-release merges to `release/*` for 1 hour? reduces churn.

devin: yes please. Keep release branch quiet. Any final blockers?

maria: none from me.

rajesh: none. Smoke passed locally.

tim: none.

sara: none.

devin: thanks all — proceeding with plan at 15:00 PT. Will post thread updates as we go. :rocket:
